1.body:
Hello,

I am writing to apply for the Web Designer position at Data Eminence, as I noticed your emphasis on creating responsive layouts and maintaining reusable design components for digital experiences.

In my current role at Ascent Business Solutions, I have delivered over 100 digital and print creatives and built reusable design templates that cut turnaround time for marketing deliverables. Earlier at AT Creation, I conducted usability testing and translated those exact findings into improved user flows and interface usability.

My Bounceless case study demonstrates my structured B2B UX process, wireframing, and user flows at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

Would you be open to a brief fifteen-minute call next week to discuss my background and how I can support your remote team?

Ananya

2.body:
Hello,

I saw your opening for a Product Designer at Digital Planet, and I am drawn to how your influencer marketing campaigns shape digital brand promotions in Pune.

During my UI/UX internship at AT Creation and my design role at Ascent Business Solutions, I translated project briefs into responsive interfaces, user flows, wireframes, and over 100 digital assets while collaborating directly with developers for smooth handoffs.

My Bounceless case study demonstrates a cleaner email verification flow and improved interface usability, which you can review alongside my other projects in my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

I am currently based in Nagpur and ready to relocate to Pune. Would you be open to a quick look at one case study or a brief call this week?

Ananya
